page.overview:
Who is Playable characters?

A playable character is the character(s) one controls in a video game. In the Final Fantasy series, the player is usually given a large cast of playable characters, but can only control a few at a time.

There are no predefined playable characters. Instead, the player creates and names their own party of characters, selecting each character's job class from the following options:

The playable cast remains the same from all other Final Fantasy VII media, with the addition of the following in the exclusive story The First Soldier:

Players create their own character through the use of the Character Creation system.
